name: Titanium Site Watch – Website Uptime Monitoring & Downtime Alerts with Health Checks for WooCommerce
author: Admin Plugins

sections.description:
Titanium Site Watch monitors WordPress uptime and health, with a dedicated 11-check WooCommerce Health diagnostic. Local checks work without a paid plan; connected plans add scheduled monitoring and alerts.

Free local tools cover WordPress/database, maintenance, AJAX/runtime and SSL; Selected WordPress Pages; required text or Element ID checks; and Signed-in Page Checks using a local Monitoring test user. Passwords, persistent login cookies, protected HTML, screenshots and WordPress user identity stay in WordPress.

When WooCommerce is active, all plans can run 11 local checks covering WooCommerce core, database, products, cart, add to cart, checkout, payments, shipping, order flow, store email and background scheduler. The isolated diagnostic does not change a customer cart/session, create an order, payment or email, contact a payment processor, calculate carrier rates or change stock.

Paid plans add external public uptime checks and, by plan, scheduled WordPress-local page, content, signed-in and WooCommerce checks. Confirmed downtime and eligible WooCommerce Health Problems can alert by email, Telegram or Discord and send recovery alerts after successful confirmation. WooCommerce Health stays separate from website uptime.

If Titanium Error Intelligence is active, Site Watch can show its compact summary and use privacy-safe critical-error event data for configured alerts. Raw logs, stack traces, SQL queries and absolute server paths are not sent.

No advertising, behavioural tracking or automatic public credits are added. Optional Site Watch badges appear only when placed by an administrator.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Titanium Site Watch.
  2. Open Site Watch in WordPress admin.
  3. Run a local WordPress check and configure optional page/content checks.
  4. If WooCommerce is active, run WooCommerce Health.
  5. Optionally connect Website Down Watch for scheduled monitoring and alerts.

External monitoring requires HTTPS. If a firewall restricts the WordPress REST API, allow the path containing titanium-site-watch; the private Site Watch key is still required.
sections.faq:
Do local checks require a Website Down Watch account?

No. Local checks work without an account. The SSL diagnostic may open a short TLS connection to this site’s own HTTPS host to inspect its certificate. Monitoring starts only after an administrator connects a plan. Price loading, USD conversion and checkout require separate actions.

What does the WooCommerce Health diagnostic check?

It checks WooCommerce core, database, products, cart, add to cart, checkout, payments, shipping, order flow, store email and background scheduler. Functional checks use an isolated temporary cart/session; operational checks are read-only. It never submits checkout or creates an order, payment or email.

How are protected pages checked?

The administrator selects a local Monitoring test user. Site Watch opens the page internally as that user and returns a compact result. The user ID, credentials, login cookies and protected HTML stay in WordPress.

Does one failed automatic request immediately send an alert?

No. Fast, Balanced or Cautious confirmation is applied before a Problem incident opens. Warning states do not notify. Recovery requires two consecutive successful checks.

How do the public status shortcodes work?

[titanium_site_watch_badge] and [titanium_site_watch_logo] are optional linked status badges. Nothing is added automatically. Their LED uses the latest synchronized monitoring state; visitor browsers do not call the monitoring API.

Does uninstalling cancel a paid subscription?

No. Disconnecting or uninstalling the plugin does not cancel the subscription. Manage it through Website Down Watch.

Which external services does Titanium Site Watch use?

Titanium Site Watch can use the services below. Local checks do not require them unless stated.

Website Down Watch monitoring API — https://site-watch-api.adminplugins.com

Used only after monitoring is connected. It can receive the license key, generated site UID/private service keys, site URL/title, configured public URLs, configured Signed-in Page Check URLs, alert recipients, intervals and opaque local check IDs/types. Scheduled local checks send compact PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE results and safe metadata. Passwords, persistent login cookies, protected HTML, screenshots, WordPress user identity and private assertion text are not sent.

Service: https://websitedownwatch.com/
Terms: https://websitedownwatch.com/terms/
Privacy: https://websitedownwatch.com/privacy-policy/

Website Down Watch alert-channel service — https://site-watch-api.adminplugins.com/channels

Used to connect or test Telegram and Discord on supported plans. It stores the Telegram chat ID/display label or encrypted Discord webhook and sends configured alerts. It does not receive WordPress passwords, login cookies, protected HTML, screenshots or WordPress user identities.

Service: https://websitedownwatch.com/
Terms: https://websitedownwatch.com/terms/
Privacy: https://websitedownwatch.com/privacy-policy/

Telegram Bot API

Used only after an administrator connects a private Telegram chat. Telegram processes the chat/account information it supplies, alert text and normal network metadata.

Terms: https://telegram.org/tos
Privacy: https://telegram.org/privacy

Discord incoming webhooks

Used only after an administrator supplies a Discord webhook and connects a supported plan. Discord processes webhook requests, alert text and normal network metadata.

Terms: https://discord.com/terms
Privacy: https://discord.com/privacy

Website Down Watch pricing service — https://site-watch-api.adminplugins.com/pricing

Contacted only after price loading is enabled. It returns public GBP plan prices and active introductory discounts. The request does not intentionally include the site URL, license key, monitored URLs, recipients or WordPress users.

Service: https://websitedownwatch.com/
Terms: https://websitedownwatch.com/terms/
Privacy: https://websitedownwatch.com/privacy-policy/

European Central Bank exchange-rate data — https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml

Contacted only after Show prices in USD is clicked. The plugin reads the daily GBP/USD reference rate for an estimated conversion and does not persist it.

Legal notice: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/home/disclaimer/html/index.en.html
Privacy: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/services/data-protection/privacy-statements/html/index.en.html

Freemius Checkout and licensing — https://checkout.freemius.com/js/v1/

Website Down Watch uses Freemius for purchases, subscriptions and licensing. Checkout JavaScript loads only after an administrator clicks a checkout button. Required license/installation data is processed when a paid site is connected, disconnected or verified.

Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/
Privacy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

Postmark

Website Down Watch uses Postmark for configured email alerts. The WordPress plugin does not receive or store the Postmark API token.

Terms: https://postmarkapp.com/terms-of-service
Privacy: https://www.activecampaign.com/legal/privacy-policy

What privacy information does Titanium Site Watch process?

Titanium Site Watch stores its settings and compact check/history data in WordPress. External transfers occur only for the enabled services above. An inactive paid subscription pauses paid monitoring but preserves the saved site identity, configuration and local history for renewal. Disconnecting the site or permanent remote removal deletes that paid connection data; Free local data can remain. Uninstall removes local plugin data only when the administrator enables deletion.

Titanium Site Watch also adds suggested disclosure text under Settings > Privacy > Policy Guide for site administrators to adapt.
